properties.description:
3 cases in crates/reflow2-core/tests/change_event_carries_its_own_text.rs. Pins the FRONT DOOR rather than the storage, which is the whole point: `upsert_node` could always hold `summary` and `rationale`, and that is exactly why nothing noticed the constructor took neither for as long as it did.

The cases are the constructor recording both fields in one call; both staying OPTIONAL, so an event with nothing to add is not forced to invent prose; and a later call that omits them NOT erasing what an earlier one wrote — the BL-183 merge promise, which is the property the two reporting projects leaned on when they worked around the gap and which therefore had to survive the gap being closed.
properties.name: A change event records why in one call
